2026-11-13.title: Friday of the Thirty-second Week in Ordinary Time
readings: Whoever abides in the teaching has both the Father and the Son
Blessed are they who follow the law of the Lord
2026-11-13.verse: Remember Lot's wife. Those who try to make their life secure will lose it, but those who lose their life will keep it.
theo: Jesus compares the day of the Son of Man to the days of Noah and of Lot. People were eating, drinking, marrying, buying, selling, planting, building, all ordinary and good things, until the flood came or fire fell. Their sin was not ordinary life; it was living as if God did not exist. Then the strange command: “Remember Lot's wife.” She was rescued from Sodom but looked back, longing for what she was leaving, and was lost. Jesus asks for an undivided heart.

The Second Letter of John, written to “the elect lady and her children” (probably a local church), joins truth and love: “this is love, that we walk according to his commandments”. Some had gone “beyond” the teaching of Christ, denying that he came in the flesh. John's answer is to abide: “Everyone who does not abide in the teaching of Christ, but goes beyond it, does not have God.” Faithfulness, not novelty, keeps us ready.
outline: Ask: if today were the last day, what would God find you doing?
Point 1 · As in the days of Noah
Ordinary life without God is the danger.
Do not look back with longing at what God asks you to leave.
Point 3 · Walk in truth and love
“Those who lose their life will keep it.”

2026-11-13.prayer: Lord Jesus, keep me ready for your coming. Do not let me live as if you did not exist, nor look back at what I have left for you. Help me to walk in truth and love and to abide in your teaching. Amen.

Remember Lot's wife: do not look back.

2026-11-13.question: What am I still looking back at?

homily: Dear friends, Jesus compares the day of the Son of Man to the days of Noah and of Lot. People were eating and drinking, marrying, buying and selling, planting and building, until the flood came or fire fell (Luke 17:26–29). None of these things is wrong. Their sin was living as if God did not exist.

Then a strange command: remember Lot's wife (Luke 17:32). She was rescued from Sodom but looked back, longing for what she was leaving, and was lost. Whoever tries to keep his life will lose it, and whoever loses it will keep it.

St John, in his second letter, gives the simple rule for these days: walk in truth and in love, according to the commandment we have had from the beginning, that we love one another (2 John 4–6). Readiness is not anxiety; it is faithfulness in ordinary days.

So let us make a short examen each night this week before sleep: where was God today, where did I forget him, what will I do better tomorrow? Then the day of the Lord will find us looking forward, not back. Amen.
kids: Children, Noah was ready when the rain came because he listened to God. Before you sleep tonight, say: thank you, sorry, and please help me tomorrow.

intro: Be ready: not living as if God did not exist, not looking back, abiding in truth and love.

points.h: As in the days of Noah
sub: Ordinary life is not the sin.
Noah obeyed while others carried on.
q: Noah did this; he did all that God commanded him.

Just as it was in the days of Noah, so too it will be in the days of the Son of Man. They were eating and drinking, and marrying and being given in marriage, until the day Noah entered the ark, and the flood came and destroyed all of them.
points.apply: Bring God into one ordinary task today.

sub: She was saved but looked back.
Longing for the old life is dangerous.
Losing life for Christ keeps it.
q: But Lot's wife, behind him, looked back, and she became a pillar of salt.
Remember Lot's wife. Those who try to make their life secure will lose it, but those who lose their life will keep it.
points.apply: Renounce one thing you still look back at.

sub: Love is walking in his commandments.
q: Happy are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the law of the LORD.
This is my commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.
points.apply: Read one paragraph of the Catechism daily.

concl: An undivided heart is ready for the Lord.
Look forward to him, not back.
2026-11-13.resolve: Make a daily examen this week before sleep.
